purpose: Offline random XY cap grasp from identical standby; nominal-model bounded-domain acceptance study

proposal.distribution: independent uniform XY over predeclared broad square, with original box translated to target XY
proposal.yaw_reason: Physical cap collider is axisymmetric; random yaw adds no geometry coverage
proposal.coverage_bound: For fixed -50 degree grasp pitch, radial upper bound 0.0037 + max over shoulder +-40deg abs(.0148*cos(q2)+.1083*sin(q2)) +.0901 + abs(.14*cos(pitch)-.002*sin(pitch)) < .267m. Proposal +-0.3m contains this fixed-pitch kinematic workspace; not a general-pitch workspace claim.
proposal.comparison: Old fixed-box XY patch is a separate baseline only; main qualification translates the original support with the cap target.
proposal.rng: numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(seed)); uniform(lower_xy, upper_xy, size=(proposal_budget,2)); 0-based proposal_index, z fixed; no other RNG draws

standby.reset: Independent trials reset robot to the same standby with qvel zero and cap to sampled supported pose; thereafter actuator-only dynamics

planner.screen: Deterministic bounded IK and finite-sample collision screen with runtime forbidden force/penetration rules; not continuous collision or dynamic feasibility certification
planner.algorithm: Analytic planar 2-link inverse after base yaw/fixed pitch elimination, enumerate radial and elbow branches; exact MuJoCo FK/limits validation; deterministic continuity branch selection

return_criteria.release: During final interval cap has force-bearing box support, no force-bearing finger contact, full projected finite-cylinder footprint inside box, and bottom within 0.5mm of box top

qualification.denominator: First 100 accepted pretrial-screened candidates, including runtime/IK/control/grasp/trace failures; no replacements
qualification.shortfall: Fewer than 100 accepted within 2000 proposals is incomplete and cannot pass
qualification.confidence_interval: Wilson 95% binomial interval; finite sample acceptance does not establish >=95% population success. After repeat-until-pass, selected batch CI is descriptive, not unconditional confirmatory coverage.

development.boundary_grid: 40 prespecified radial/yaw probes: radii [.13,.15,.18,.21,.225]m crossed with 8 equally spaced yaw angles from -pi inclusive to pi exclusive; all statically accepted probes plus first8 accepted iid random candidates

scope_limits: Uncalibrated nominal scene and material assumptions
Only fixed -50deg grip-pitch workspace inside the broad proposal, restricted by the stated finite-sample standby path screen
No reachability guarantee outside tested domain

controller_setdown.mode: perfect simulated-state feedback from MuJoCo cap pose and contact forces, not a hardware estimator
controller_setdown.command: During lower latch current commanded arm q and target at first threshold crossing; stop descending, open jaw on scheduled release, retract continuously along already-screened vertical lift path from latched fraction to pregrasp
